footer.descrizione: An independent platform for those who write and those who truly read. No screaming algorithms. Just books, stories, essays, articles — suspended in glass, kept alive by those who choose them.

home.heroDesc: A library suspended in glass. Books, stories, essays and articles published directly by the authors, with no screaming algorithms. Only <keyword>parole_vive</keyword>.
home.evidenzaDesc: A novel, a story, an essay, a poem. Digital pixels and ink, but with teeth.
home.r01d: The writer decides what to publish, what to make downloadable, what to keep protected. Always.
home.r02d: Reviews, chapter-by-chapter comments, the ability to follow who moves you. The community is the backbone.
home.r03d: Transparent filters: most read, most recent, by genre. You choose what to read — not an AI doing it for you.
home.cestinoDesc: Rejected, forgotten, abandoned stories. They rest in the dark, waiting for a verdict. Five readers are enough to bring them back into the catalogue, with the permanent badge "Rescued by readers". You could be one of them.
home.autoreDesc: Publish directly: books, stories, essays or articles. Keep your rights, choose what's downloadable, receive donations from readers who follow you.
home.lettoreDesc: Free access to all public content. Comment, follow authors, download within the set limits, support those you love with a free donation.
home.taglineCassetto: Let them out of the drawer,
home.taglineCassettoSub: the books that never saw the light.

abbonamento.sottotitolo: Reading is a right, and it's free. Publishing has a cost, and we want to explain why.
abbonamento.sezione1Desc: Every author can publish their first work without paying anything. We want you to see with your own eyes how the platform works, how your book looks, how readers respond. Only after that — if you want to continue — does the subscription come in.
abbonamento.ottieni01: PDF, ePub and MOBI downloads for your readers
abbonamento.sezione3Intro: Liberiamo la mente has no investors, no advertising, and doesn't sell your data. The costs come from three places:
abbonamento.costo01Desc: Every published work takes up space: text, cover, PDF and ePub files. The database that tracks readers, reviews and bookmarks runs on professional infrastructure that costs money every month, regardless of traffic.
abbonamento.costo02Desc: We offer the option to generate a professional cover using artificial intelligence. Each generation has a real cost: we pay for the image models for every cover created.
abbonamento.costo03Desc: When a reader follows you, when someone reviews your work, when you send a newsletter to your readers — every message has an infrastructure cost.
abbonamento.costo04Desc: Turning your text into PDF, ePub and MOBI compatible with every device requires specialized services that we pay for by usage.
abbonamento.sezione4Desc: €12 a year. One euro a month. Less than the cost of a coffee. This isn't a price meant to make a profit — it's the minimum needed to keep the platform running and independent. Readers pay nothing: access to the catalogue is, and will remain, free. It's you, as an author, whose contribution allows all of this to exist.
abbonamento.vantaggio02: Direct donations from readers, no middlemen
abbonamento.sezione6Desc: A short 10-second cinematic video clip, generated by artificial intelligence from your work's description — something no other self-publishing platform offers. The result cannot be edited or regenerated for free: each generation uses up a credit.
abbonamento.piano2Desc: Author subscription + 1200 promotional video credits (up to 100 total seconds, depending on the duration chosen for each video).
abbonamento.paypalNota: After sending your contribution via PayPal, write to us (through the contact form or by replying to the confirmation email) letting us know which package you chose: we activate the subscription and credits manually, usually within a day.
